response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_of_group_telescope_count FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) g

assumptions.assumption: The number of telescopes in a group is COUNT(*) of the telescope rows after the join and filter. Telescopes with NULL bandusagepct still count, and NULL pointaccarc rows are excluded by the > 4.86 filter.
Groups whose average bandwidth usage is NULL (all values missing) are ignored in the average of averages, which AVG does by default. Their counts are still included in the average of counts.
